meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后,当你提出问题时,Claude 会召集团队式的“心灵议会”,选出多个思维类型各异的成员,各自陈述立场、推理、风险与洞见,最后给出包含共识、核心矛盾、盲点和建议路径的综合结论。
howto.when: 当你想从多个角度看问题(如要求议会式讨论),或说出“council mode”“mind council”等触发词,或面临两难抉择时触发。

say.text: 用心灵议会帮我分析该不该跳槽到创业公司
say.note: 会召集多个思维原型,给出多角度评估。

say.text: 开一个快速议会,评估这个活动的潜在风险
say.note: 快速模式使用 3 名成员,回答更简短。

say.text: 用魔鬼代言人模式,试试推翻我的计划
say.note: 每位成员都会反对最直观的结论。

howto.what_en: Claude turns your question into a multi-perspective Mind Council: picks 4-6 archetypes, each gives a stance, reasoning, risk, insight; then outputs a synthesis with convergence, core tension, blind spot, and a recommended path.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for multiple viewpoints, a council/panel discussion, say 'council mode' or 'mind council', or face a dilemma with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Use a Mind Council to analyze whether I should switch to a startup job.
say_en.note: Summons multiple thinking archetypes for a multi-angle assessment.

say_en.text: Run a quick council to assess the risks of this event.
say_en.note: Quick mode uses 3 members with shorter answers.

say_en.text: Use devil's advocate mode to try to refute my plan.
say_en.note: Every member argues against the most intuitive conclusion.
